Sabb. 33 b חַיֵּי עולם everlasting life (future world), ח' שעה temporary life (physical wants).—חיי נפש necessaries of life. Y. Ned. IX, 42 c כביסה ח' נ' washing clothes belongs to the necessaries of life (which the poor must be supplied with). Ib. ח' העיר הזאת the support of the poor of one’s own place. Pes. 113 b חַיֵּיהֶם אינם חיים whose life is no life (deserving the name); a. v. fr.—חַיֶּיךָ, בְּחַ' by thy life!, as thou livest! Lev. R. s. 15; a. v. fr.—Ber. 3 a, a. e. חַיֶּיךָ וחַיֵּי ראשך by thy life, and by thy head!—יורד עמו (עד) לחַיָּיו persecutes him even as far as to deprive him of his livelihood. Kidd. 28 a. Ex. R. s. 1, beg.; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 19 בית חַיֵּינוּ our house of life (the Temple). Mekh. Yithro, Amal., s. 2 (ref. to Ex. XVIII, 20) הודע להם בית חַיֵּיהֶם make known to them their house of life (prayer, study; v. Targ. Y. Ex. l. c.); B. Mets. 30 b; B. Kam. 99 b, sq. (v. comment.).—[חַיִּים the living ones, v. חַי.]

חתא pera a. trabs, P. Sm. 1408) pouch, bag. Gitt. 45 b ח' דתפילי a bag containing T’fillin. Ḥull. 45 a (by play on חייתא life a. bag) וסימניך ח' דמתנח ביה וכ' and thy sign (to remember which of the two skins is essential for life), the bag in which the cerebrum lies. Keth. 93 a; B. Ib. כל … אמחיה ח' ופלגא I will give each of you one blow with the whole bag, and one blow with half of it.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חָלַל); profanação, difamação.; resgate de objetos sagrados, secularização.; a perda do status sacerdotal, tornando-se um ḥ alal (v. חָלָל II).
definicoes_originais: the loss of priestly status, becoming a ḥ alal (v. חָלָל II).
notas_originais: Y. Shebu. VI, end, 37 b ח' שבועה the desecration committed by an unnecessary oath. Sabb. 33 a, a. fr. ח' שבת desecration of the Sabbath; ח' השם defamation of the Name of the Lord, disgracing the Jewish religion. Yoma 86 a ה"ד ח' השם what act, for instance, would be a profanation &c.?—Kidd. 40 a אין מקיפין בח' וכ', v. נָקַף I, II. Ber. 19 b; a. fr.
Ib. 35 a טעון ח' requires redemption. Y. Naz. II, beg. 51 d משמשין לשון ח' mean redemption; a. fr.— Pl. חִילּוּלִים, חִלּ'. Y. Peah VII, 20 b bot. (interpret. הלולים, Lev. XIX, 24), v. ה"א.

Y. Ter. VII, 44 d bot. את שחִילּוּלָהּ וכ' whose loss of priesthood was caused by &c.— Pl. חִילּוּלִין, חִלּ'. Keth. 29 b ח' הוא עושה he causes loss of priesthood (to his offspring). Snh. 50 b בחִילּוּלֵי שבזנות וכ' the text speaks of desecration effected through illicit intercourse (not of Sabbath breaking).—[Sifré Deut. s. 26, v. preced. w.]

notas_originais: Tosef. Succ. I, 10 של קנים ושל ח' (a matting) of reeds or rushes; Succ. 20 a Ar. (ed. חילת, Ms. M. חולית). Sot. 49 b Ar. (ed. חילת).—Kel. XVII, 17.—[ Pl. חִילְפִין, v. חֲלִיפִין a. חֵלֶף.]

Gitt. 68 b bot.— Pl. חִילְפֵי, חִלְ'. Ḥull. 62 b, v. כְּרָזָא.—ח' דְיַמָּא sea-rush, Schoenanth, Juncus odoratus (v. Löw Pfl., p. 168; Sm. Ant. s. v. Schoenus), a spice. Gitt. l. c. חילפא וח' דימא rush and sea-rush. Ber. 43 b.—[Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 12 only חילפי, v. גַּלִּי.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (חלף) uma espécie de salgueiro com folhas serrilhadas (v. precedido .; Fl. para Levy Targ. Dict. I, 425 1 “assim chamado por seu rápido crescimento”).
definicoes_originais: (חלף) a species of willow with serried leaves (v. preced.; Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, 425 1 “so called from its fast growth”).
notas_originais: Succ. 34 a משכחת לה בח' גילא Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. כי תניא האי בח' וכ') (‘a willow the leaves of which are not serried like the teeth of a saw, but like those of a sickle’) refers to a willow with rounded leaves.—[Ib. ח' ערבתא Rashi, v. חִלְפְתָא.]— Pl. חִילְפֵי. Sabb. 152 a סבותא כלילא דח' old age is a crown of willow rods (heavy to wear). Ib. 77 b. Snh. 44 a, v. אָסָא III.

definicoes_originais: (חָלַק; cmp. Lat. alica, halica, a. חֵילֶק I) split grain, grist, spelt used for halica (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Alica).
notas_originais: Makhsh. VI, 2 חילקה Mish. (Talm. ed. חֲלִיקָה). Y. Sabb. I, 3 c bot. M.
